name: The COHERENT Experiment at the Spallation Neutron Source

summary.plain: The 2015 plan describing how COHERENT would try to catch neutrinos bouncing off whole atomic nuclei for the first time, using several different detector materials at a neutron-making machine in Tennessee.
summary.technical: COHERENT's founding proposal (arXiv:1509.08702, Sept. 2015): physics motivation, sensitivity projections, and a phased four-year deployment plan for a 14 kg CsI[Na] crystal, 15 kg of p-type point-contact germanium detectors, and a 100 kg two-phase liquid-xenon TPC in the SNS basement ("Neutrino Alley").
